items.project: Palm Jebel Ali – Fronds A–D villas
items.title: Nakheel awards AED1.4bn build contract for 176 Palm Jebel Ali villas
items.summary: Nakheel has awarded the construction contract for 176 villas on fronds A to D of Palm Jebel Ali, comprising 128 beach and 48 coral villas, with completion expected within 24 months of works starting.

items.title: Dubai Harbour Residences reaches topping-out
items.summary: Khansaheb has marked the topping-out of Dubai Harbour Residences, a low-rise beachfront apartment development by H&H for Shamal, alongside hotels in the wider scheme. H&H said in July that Buildings A and B were expected to top out in the following quarter.
